records.title: Find help navigating your transition
records.geography: Wisconsin; ask about support in your community.
records.summary: VetsNet connects service members, veterans and families with community support. It also offers a transition-sponsor route.
records.caveat: Ask which services fit your needs. Its Onward Ops sponsorship route is a separate service from Transition OPS.
records.action: Contact VetsNet through its official transition page to ask about a navigator or transition sponsor for your Wisconsin plans.
records.label: Ask VetsNet about transition support
records.population: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may ask about community navigation; sponsor suitability is reviewed by the provider.
records.excluded: No VA benefit enrollment, VA endorsement, accredited claims representation, guaranteed sponsor availability or Transition OPS affiliation is established.
records.independentRating: Charity Navigator direct read: 89%, three stars, one of four beacons; accountability/finance only. No member-outcome conclusion.
records.tier: TIER 2; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.band: Condition-triggered inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.expires: NONE; provider service area, availability and operating information must be checked when contacting it.
records.ogcApplicability: Not a claims-representation referral; OGC not applicable to the narrow navigation act. Keep official accredited-claims route separate.
records.identityEvidence: Root browser read IRS TEOS identity, Publication 78 Yes and deductibility code PC; determination/returns were listed where applicable. No unobserved revocation status or tax guarantee inferred. Receipt: irs-vetsnet-browser.txt

records.title: Ask about housing help for your household
records.geography: Participating Wisconsin counties; check CVI’s county list.
records.summary: CVI’s SSVF program supports eligible low-income veteran households facing homelessness or housing loss.
records.caveat: CVI reviews your housing situation, eligibility and county. A referral does not guarantee funding or a place to stay.
records.action: Review the county list on CVI’s SSVF page, then contact its intake team for a housing assessment.
records.label: Check CVI housing support
records.population: ALREADY SEPARATED and SPOUSE/FAMILY within eligible veteran households; GUARD/RESERVE only where independently qualified under SSVF veteran criteria. SEPARATING members may inquire for planning, not assume current eligibility.
records.excluded: Not all Wisconsin counties; not every CVI program has the same area. No automatic eligibility from Guard/Reserve service, family relationship or app state selection. No current housing vacancy or benefit amount is certified.
records.independentRating: Charity Navigator direct read: 90%, four stars, one of four beacons; accountability/finance only. No housing-outcome conclusion.
records.tier: TIER 2; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.band: Condition-triggered inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.expires: NONE; provider service area, availability and operating information must be checked when contacting it.
records.ogcApplicability: Housing/intake referral, not claims representation; OGC not applicable to the narrow act.
records.identityEvidence: Root browser read IRS TEOS identity, Publication 78 Yes and deductibility code PC; determination/returns were listed where applicable. No unobserved revocation status or tax guarantee inferred. Receipt: irs-cvi-browser.txt

records.title: Find food and essentials in Racine
records.summary: VOW’s Veterans Marketplace provides food and personal-care items for veterans and surviving spouses.
records.caveat: Check registration requirements and shopping hours before visiting. This is a food-support referral, not a housing placement.
records.action: Open the Veterans Marketplace page, check its registration requirements and hours, and contact VOW with questions before visiting.
records.label: Check VOW Marketplace details
records.population: ALREADY SEPARATED and SPOUSE/FAMILY limited here to surviving spouses; current GUARD/RESERVE or SEPARATING members must ask the provider whether their circumstances and service proof qualify.
records.excluded: Not all spouses, no statewide mobile market claim, no housing vacancy, no imported stale pantry hours or address.
